testcase.name: automatic sizing respects platform limits and supports unknown CPU counts
thread configuration accepts auto and rejects malformed or overflowing overrides
supported platforms execute jobs concurrently on distinct threads
exclusive slots; nested batches; reuse; errors; barriers and reconfiguration
deferred batches complete with lanes and isolated errors
lane groups run in index order and the horizon is bounded
workers run deferred batches earliest due first and the owner only waits
without workers the owner runs the jobs due no later than the join
a lane keeps submission order: a lane job due before a live earlier one is rejected
the slot count covers every producer's horizon
presentation cannot delay simulation barriers with spare workers or run on the simulation owner
with one worker the owner waits through its presentation chunk and never runs the join itself
presentation progresses before a continuous simulation backlog drains
presentation replacement, chunk pumping, cancellation and errors retain no captures
resumable presentation yields without advancing or retaining canceled inputs
